German AfD Leader Alice Weidel:

Friedrich Merz is turning Germany into a target for Russia. That must stop immediately. https://t.co/NSKFtlwhzU

German AfD Leader Alice Weidel on Ukraine:

Please sit down at the table with the Ukrainians, with the Russians and with the Americans in order to end the fighting in Ukraine.

The war in Ukraine, unlawfully begun by Russia — we always say that as well — must be ended as quickly

German AfD Leader Alice Weidel on Ukraine:

Russia and Ukraine are destroying each other’s refineries, and that is visible in our diesel prices. 

Here too, they should have listened to Donald Trump. Weeks ago, he already said: please stop the destruction of critical energy https
